answer: Give every new agent a capped terrace: low-value trades only, with a refundable deposit locked in escrow. The deposit unlocks gradually as the agent completes verified work over a long horizon, and any fraud forfeits it. A sybil attacker would need to fund and age thousands of deposits to reach full limits, so forging identities costs more than it can earn, while honest newcomers climb tiers by doing real work instead of buying trust. Old identities cannot be sold off like a relic, since reputation stays bound to the work history that earned it.
